basic_info.description: 1 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 80% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person=$83,900; for 2 people=$ 95,900; for 3 people=$107,900; for 4 people=$119,900; for 5 people=$129,500. Must be first time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring, & other restrictions. Fair Housing Opportunity. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date April 8, 2025. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre approval, and homebuyer education verification due on April 29, 2025.  This large Edwardian condominium in lower Pacific Heights features hardwood floors and a totally renovated bathroom and kitchen. This unit has two rooms that could be used as bedrooms. It also comes with washer/dryer hookups.
